title: One position or residual group in an emergency-flatten result
description: Source: src/box/flattenOutcome.ts classifyPositionClose() / classifyResidualFlatten(). CLOSED so an added field is caught. `disposition` is ordered by strength of evidence: flat_on_fill_evidence is derived from the fills THIS PROCESS observed and applied, which is the strongest signal available at the end of a flatten but is NOT an independent re-read of broker positions — `settlement.reconciled` is what speaks to durable/broker agreement. `remaining_quantity` null means UNKNOWN, never zero; 0 is written only for flat_on_fill_evidence.

id.description: Position id, or the durable recovery-attempt id for a residual group.

label.description: Operator-readable label (underlying/expiry/strikes, or the residual symbols). Null when not determinable.

reason.description: Why, in operator-readable prose. Null only for flat_on_fill_evidence.

remaining_quantity.description: Quantity still outstanding for this item. NULL MEANS UNKNOWN. 0 appears only for flat_on_fill_evidence.

remaining_by_role.description: Per-leg breakdown where one exists, keyed by Box leg role. Null when unknown or not applicable.
